audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph Nathan oracle and Davidic covenant, first-pass restored draft with public-domain scaffold; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed against 2 Samuel 7 for Nathan's initial approval and correction, mobile Divine presence, David's elevation, enemy-cutting and land language, dynastic promise, father-son metaphor, David's prayer, nation comparison, and conquest memory.

verses.restored: When David lived in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet, Look, I live in house of cedar, but ark of covenant of YHWH is under curtains.

familiar.text: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.

modern.text: After David had settled into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”

original.text: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הָֽאֲרָזִ֔ים וַאֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת יְרִיעֽוֹת

verses.restored: Nathan said to David, Do all in your heart, for Divine is with you.

familiar.text: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

modern.text: And Nathan replied to David, “Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔יד כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ

verses.restored: That night word of Divine came to Nathan, saying,

familiar.text: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

modern.text: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

original.text: וַֽיְהִ֖י בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֑וּא וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל נָתָ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Go and say to David my servant, Thus says YHWH: You shall not build me a house to live in.

familiar.text: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

modern.text: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell.

original.text: לֵ֤ךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל דָּוִ֣יד עַבְדִּ֔י כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א אַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה לִּ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת לָשָֽׁבֶת

verses.restored: For I have not lived in a house from day I brought Israel up to this day, but went from tent to tent and from dwelling to dwelling.

familiar.text: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

modern.text: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved from tent to tent and dwelling to dwelling.

original.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ בְּבַ֔יִת מִן הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶעֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָֽאֶהְיֶ֛ה מֵאֹ֥הֶל אֶל אֹ֖הֶל וּמִמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Wherever I walked with all Israel, did I speak a word to any judges of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, Why have you not built me a cedar house?

familiar.text: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

modern.text: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’

original.text: בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲדָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת אַחַד֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתִי לִרְע֥וֹת אֶת עַמִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֛מָּה לֹא בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים

verses.restored: Now say to my servant David, Thus says YHWH of armies: I took you from pasture, from following sheep, to be ruler over my people Israel.

familiar.text: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

modern.text: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.

original.text: וְ֠עַתָּה כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֞ר לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְדָוִ֗יד כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן הַנָּוֶ֔ה מִֽן אַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן לִהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: I was with you wherever you walked, cut off enemies before you, and made you a name like names of great ones on earth.

familiar.text: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

modern.text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like the greatest in the land.

original.text: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָאַכְרִ֥ית אֶת כָּל אוֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתִֽי לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֔ם כְּשֵׁ֥ם הַגְּדוֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: I will appoint a place for my people Israel and plant them, that they may dwell in their place and not be disturbed again; violent people shall not waste them as formerly,

familiar.text: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

modern.text: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning

original.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְעַמִּ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּ֨יהוּ֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְלֹא יוֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵי עַוְלָה֙ לְבַלֹּת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָֽה

verses.restored: from days I appointed judges over my people Israel. I will subdue enemies. I tell you YHWH will build you a house.

familiar.text: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

modern.text: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you.

original.text: וּלְמִיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִכְנַ֖עְתִּי אֶת כָּל אוֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וָאַגִּ֣ד לָ֔ךְ וּבַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה לְּךָ֥ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: When your days are fulfilled and you go to ancestors, I will raise offspring after you, one of your sons, and establish his kingdom.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

modern.text: And when your days are fulfilled and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי מָלְא֤וּ יָמֶ֨יךָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִם אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲקִֽימוֹתִ֤י אֶֽת זַרְעֲךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה מִבָּנֶ֑יךָ וַהֲכִינוֹתִ֖י אֶת מַלְכוּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne for an age/enduringly.

familiar.text: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

modern.text: He will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.

original.text: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה לִּ֖י בָּ֑יִת וְכֹנַנְתִּ֥י אֶת כִּסְא֖וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: I will be father to him, and he shall be son to me; I will not remove covenant-love from him as I removed it from one before you.

familiar.text: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

modern.text: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. And I will never remove My loving devotion from him as I removed it from your predecessor.

original.text: אֲנִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶה לּ֣וֹ לְאָ֔ב וְה֖וּא יִֽהְיֶה לִּ֣י לְבֵ֑ן וְחַסְדִּי֙ לֹא אָסִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲסִיר֔וֹתִי מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה לְפָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: I will set him in my house and kingdom enduringly, and his throne shall be established for an age.

familiar.text: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

modern.text: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.”

original.text: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתִּ֛יהוּ בְּבֵיתִ֥י וּבְמַלְכוּתִ֖י עַד הָעוֹלָ֑ם וְכִסְא֕וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: According to all these words and all this vision, Nathan spoke to David.

familiar.text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

modern.text: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire vision. David’s Prayer of Thanksgiving (2 Samuel 7:18–29)

original.text: כְּכֹל֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּכְכֹ֖ל הֶחָז֣וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל דָּוִֽיד

verses.restored: King David came and sat before YHWH and said, Who am I, YHWH Divine, and what is my house, that you brought me this far?

familiar.text: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

modern.text: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?

original.text: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִֽי אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ וּמִ֣י בֵיתִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖נִי עַד הֲלֹֽם

verses.restored: This was small in your eyes, Divine; you have spoken concerning servant's house for a distant future and regarded me according to a high human rank, YHWH Divine.

familiar.text: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

modern.text: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O LORD God.

original.text: וַתִּקְטַ֨ן זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר עַל בֵּֽית עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּרְאִיתַ֗נִי כְּת֧וֹר הָאָדָ֛ם הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? You know your servant.

familiar.text: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

modern.text: What more can David say to You for so honoring Your servant? For You know Your servant,

original.text: מַה יּוֹסִ֨יף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛יד אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְכָב֣וֹד אֶת עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת עַבְדְּךָ֥ יָדָֽעְתָּ

verses.restored: YHWH, for your servant and according to your heart, you have done all this greatness, making known these great things.

familiar.text: O LORD, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

modern.text: O LORD. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed all Your greatness.

original.text: יְהוָ֕ה בַּעֲב֤וּר עַבְדְּךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת כָּל הַגְּדֻלּֽוֹת

verses.restored: YHWH, none is like you, and no Divine besides you, according to all heard with our ears.

familiar.text: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

modern.text: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.

original.text: יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֔וֹךָ וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: What other nation on earth is like your people Israel, whom Divine went to redeem as a people, to make a name by great and awe-inspiring acts, driving nations from before your people redeemed from Egypt?

familiar.text: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

modern.text: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself? You made a name for Yourself through great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt.

original.text: וּמִי֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לִפְדּ֧וֹת ל֣וֹ עָ֗ם לָשׂ֤וּם לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֚ם גְּדֻלּ֣וֹת וְנֹרָא֔וֹת לְגָרֵ֗שׁ מִפְּנֵ֧י עַמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִ֥יתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם גּוֹיִֽם

verses.restored: You made your people Israel your people enduringly, and you, YHWH, became their Divine.

familiar.text: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.

modern.text: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.

original.text: וַ֠תִּתֵּן אֶת עַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: Now, YHWH, let word spoken concerning servant and house be established enduringly; do as you spoke.

familiar.text: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

modern.text: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל בֵּית֔וֹ יֵאָמֵ֖ן עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ

verses.restored: Let it be established, that your name may be magnified enduringly, saying, YHWH of armies is Divine of Israel, a Divine to Israel; and house of David your servant shall be established before you.

familiar.text: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

modern.text: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.

original.text: וְ֠יֵֽאָמֵן וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדְּךָ֖ נָכ֥וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: For you, my Divine, uncovered to servant that you will build him a house; therefore servant found courage to pray before you.

familiar.text: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

modern.text: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.

original.text: כִּ֣י אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י גָּלִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת אֹ֣זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת עַל כֵּן֙ מָצָ֣א עַבְדְּךָ֔ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Now, YHWH, you are Divine and have spoken this good concerning servant.

familiar.text: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

modern.text: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אַתָּה ה֖וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ עַֽל עַבְדְּךָ֔ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת

verses.restored: Now let it please you to bless house of servant, that it may be before you enduringly; for you, YHWH, have blessed, and it is blessed for an age.

familiar.text: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.

modern.text: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”

original.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאַ֨לְתָּ֙ לְבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּמְבֹרָ֖ךְ לְעוֹלָֽם

translation_notes: Nathan initially endorses David's desire without inquiry and is corrected that night. Spiritual leaders can speak too quickly and must revise public counsel.
YHWH explicitly describes mobile presence from tent to tent; no temple, institution, nation, or clergy can contain or own the Divine.
David's rise from shepherd to ruler does not establish leader immunity; shepherd language intensifies responsibility toward vulnerable people.
Enemy-cutting, planting, and driving-nations language belongs to ancient royal theology and may not authorize modern conquest or ethnic cleansing.
The Davidic covenant is Jewish covenantal scripture. It may not be appropriated through Christian supersessionism, hereditary divine-right monarchy, or modern dynastic claims.
Father-son royal metaphor does not excuse abusive parenting, corporal punishment, or unaccountable rulers.
The Chronicler omits the explicit discipline clause of 2 Samuel 7:14; the difference must be audited rather than used to make monarchy unconditional.
David's prayer idealizes Israel's uniqueness through displacement of nations; election must be read as vocation and responsibility, not human superiority.
'Forever' language has semantic and historical complexity, especially given exile and monarchy's end.
safety_note: Do not use this covenant to establish royal, clerical, national, or Christian immunity and do not use land or enemy language for modern dispossession. Preserve Nathan's correction, Divine mobility, Jewish covenant integrity, leader accountability, and the humanity of displaced nations.
